info.title: Digital Twin API
info.description: Digital Twin - Car Health Monitoring Platform backend. Phase 1 provides vehicle registration and raw telemetry storage.

get.description: Returns service liveness information. Does not touch the database.
Runs a lightweight SELECT 1 to verify database reachability.

post.description: Register a new account. The caller never supplies a role.

schema.title: Response Register Api V1 Auth Register Post

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a token pair
post.description:
Login. A 401 is returned for a bad email, a bad password, and an
inactive account alike, so the existence of an email can never be probed.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token for a fresh token pair
post.description: Each refresh rotates the token; the previous one is revoked.

Revoke the given refresh token. Idempotent: repeating a logout or
logging out with an unknown token still returns 204.

patch.description: Self-service update. Only full_name may be changed here.

get.description: Paginated list of the caller's vehicles, newest first.

post.description: Register a new vehicle owned by the caller. The VIN must be unique.

get.description: Returns a single vehicle by ID, if the caller owns it.

patch.description: Updates mutable vehicle metadata. The VIN is immutable.

delete.description: Deletes the vehicle and cascades to its telemetry records.

post.description: Store a single telemetry sample for a vehicle the caller owns.

get.description: Paginated list of a vehicle's telemetry, newest first. Supports optional time-range filtering with start_time and end_time.

post.description: Run a deterministic health analysis over the vehicle's recent telemetry window, persist a new health snapshot, and return the generated Vehicle Health Context. Optionally override the analysis window size with window_minutes.

get.description: Returns the latest persisted Vehicle Health Context for the vehicle.
Paginated list of a vehicle's health snapshots, newest first. Supports optional date filtering with start_time and end_time on generated_at.

post.summary: Ask a natural-language question about a vehicle
post.description: Interprets the vehicle's latest Health Context through the reasoning agent and returns a grounded, persisted structured diagnosis.

post.summary: Diagnose a critical telemetry rule event
post.description: Runs a critical-event diagnosis. Repeated events for the same vehicle and rule set within the cooldown window return the existing diagnosis instead of calling the LLM again.

get.description: Reads-only snapshot for dashboards: the latest health context, the latest agent diagnosis and its age. Never invokes the LLM.
Paginated list of a vehicle's agent diagnoses, newest first.
Returns the most recent agent diagnosis for the vehicle.
Enabled state, pgvector availability, adapter identities, corpus counts.
Retrieve evidence with provenance. Optional vehicle scope filters the corpus (make/model/year). No LLM involved.

post.description: Validates the multipart file and metadata, then runs it through the existing RAG ingestion pipeline (Docling/text parsing, structure-aware chunking, BGE-M3 embeddings, pgvector). Supported document formats follow the parser registry: .pdf .docx .doc .rtf .pptx .ppt .html .mhtml .xlsx .xls .txt .md .text.

get.description: Paginated corpus documents (newest first) with version counts. Optional exact filters: make, model, canonical; model-year range via year; documents having a version with the given ingestion status.
Document identity metadata plus its immutable version history (content hash, parser, chunk counts, ingestion status per version).

delete.description: Transactionally removes the document, all of its immutable versions and every chunk/vector row. RAG search stops returning its content immediately.

AdminRagDocumentDetailResponse.title: AdminRagDocumentDetailResponse
AdminRagDocumentDetailResponse.description: One document plus its immutable version history (each with chunk count).

AdminRagUploadResponse.title: AdminRagUploadResponse
AdminRagUploadResponse.description:
Outcome of one admin upload, using the existing ingestion semantics.

``status`` is ``ingested`` (a new document/version was persisted) or
``unchanged`` (identical content already completed — Phase 5 idempotency).
A failed ingestion raises instead of returning a fabricated success.

AgentDiagnosisItem.title: AgentDiagnosisItem
AgentDiagnosisItem.description: Lightweight history entry exposing the queryable diagnosis columns.

AgentQueryRequest.title: AgentQueryRequest
AgentQueryRequest.description: A natural-language question about a vehicle.

AnalysisWindow.title: AnalysisWindow
AnalysisWindow.description: The historical telemetry window an analysis was performed over.

BaselineInsight.title: BaselineInsight
BaselineInsight.description: Comparison of current telemetry against the vehicle's historical baseline.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: One grounded citation: which chunk of which immutable version backs it.

ConfidenceAnalysis.title: ConfidenceAnalysis
ConfidenceAnalysis.description: Confidence assessment anchored to deterministic context quality.

rule_ids.title: Rule Ids
rule_ids.description: Rule ids that triggered the critical event; derived from the context when omitted.

CriticalEventRequest.title: CriticalEventRequest
CriticalEventRequest.description: A critical telemetry rule event to diagnose (rule ids optional).

DashboardResponse.title: DashboardResponse
DashboardResponse.description: Dashboard hook: current health context plus latest diagnosis (no LLM).

DataQuality.title: DataQuality
DataQuality.description:
Data-quality characteristics of the analysed telemetry window.

Missing samples are a data-quality concern, not a vehicle fault.

DiagnosisContent.title: DiagnosisContent
DiagnosisContent.description:
The interpreted diagnosis produced by the reasoning layer.

Content is anchored to the Vehicle Health Context; anything that cannot be
grounded in that context is removed during validation.

When the Manufacturer Guidance Tool supplied evidence, the model may add a
``manufacturer_guidance`` note and ``cited_sources`` references. Only refs
that resolve to *actually retrieved* evidence survive validation; titles,
page ranges and document ids are rebuilt app-side from the tool result.

DiagnosisResponse.title: DiagnosisResponse
DiagnosisResponse.description: The full agent response returned by the API.

EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem
EvidenceItem.description:
One grounded piece of evidence the diagnosis is based on.

Every item must trace to a real rule finding or metric statistic present
in the Vehicle Health Context; anything else is dropped during grounding.

ExecutionMetadata.title: ExecutionMetadata
ExecutionMetadata.description: Provider execution details for the call that produced the diagnosis.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description:
A deterministic, factual observation produced by the rule engine.

Findings describe telemetry-derived evidence only. They never state a
mechanical diagnosis (e.g. "water pump failed").

HealthContextResponse.title: HealthContextResponse
HealthContextResponse.description: The complete serialized Vehicle Health Context returned by the API.

HealthSnapshotItem.title: HealthSnapshotItem
HealthSnapshotItem.description: Lightweight history entry exposing queryable top-level columns.

Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis
Hypothesis.description: A possible cause. Wording must treat it as a hypothesis, not a verdict.

ManufacturerEvidence.title: ManufacturerEvidence
ManufacturerEvidence.description:
Bounded metadata for one retrieved manufacturer source shown to the LLM.

Full chunk text is never copied into the diagnosis; only provenance,
scores and a short excerpt are persisted so the record stays auditable and
JSON-serializable.

MetricStatistics.title: MetricStatistics
MetricStatistics.description: Statistical summary of a single numeric telemetry metric.

PenaltyComponent.title: PenaltyComponent
PenaltyComponent.description: Per-category penalty applied towards the health score.

RAGDocumentSummary.title: RAGDocumentSummary
RAGDocumentSummary.description: Read-only admin view of one document in the corpus.

RAGHealthResponse.title: RAGHealthResponse
RAGHealthResponse.description: RAG diagnostics: enabled state, backend availability, corpus counts.

RAGSearchResult.title: RAGSearchResult
RAGSearchResult.description: Structured retrieval result (no LLM involved — pure evidence).

RAGVersionSummary.title: RAGVersionSummary
RAGVersionSummary.description: Read-only admin view of one immutable document version.

RecommendedAction.title: RecommendedAction
RecommendedAction.description: A recommended next action, categorized for downstream handling.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description: Create a user account. Role and is_active are never client-controlled.

RetrievedEvidence.title: RetrievedEvidence
RetrievedEvidence.description: One retrieved chunk with provenance and the full scoring trail.

ScoreDetails.title: ScoreDetails
ScoreDetails.description: Transparent breakdown of how the health score was computed.

SeverityAnalysis.title: SeverityAnalysis
SeverityAnalysis.description: How the assessed severity relates to the deterministic rule severity.

TelemetryCreate.title: TelemetryCreate
TelemetryCreate.description: A single raw telemetry sample submitted for a vehicle.

TrendInsight.title: TrendInsight
TrendInsight.description: Detected direction of change for a single metric over the window.

UserProfileUpdate.title: UserProfileUpdate
UserProfileUpdate.description: Fields a user may update about themselves.

VehicleScope.title: VehicleScope
VehicleScope.description:
Vehicle identity used to scope/filter retrieved evidence.

All fields stay ``None`` when unknown — nothing is ever invented or
guessed by the retrieval layer.

VehicleUpdate.title: VehicleUpdate
VehicleUpdate.description:
Mutable vehicle metadata.

Ownership, lifecycle (status/source_type/simulation_enabled), VIN and the
security-relevant fields are intentionally not mutable through this schema
for self-service users; VIN is immutable after creation.
